units: August-centered latents divided by RMS August vector norm; PC1, PC2, PC3
readout: Signed mean of readout(z + dose * RMS * d) - readout(z) on 1024 October anchors; frozen LayerNorm and MuReadout.
response_definition: Paired mean of edited minus unedited observer outputs over the same 1024 October windows. Units are odd-August observer-target standard deviations.

concepts.label: Signed loop imbalance
concepts.description: Half the forward minus reverse observed cycle sum.

concepts.label: Mean pair spread
concepts.description: Mean spread across the three pairs at the anchor.

concepts.label: Missing-history fraction
concepts.description: Fraction of the 96 directed edge slots missing in the 16 input frames.

concepts.label: Log observed loop dispersion
concepts.description: Log of one plus the standard deviation of imbalance across fully observed frames.
